allocation_scope: Sampled GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false) observation; whole profile only, never exact bytes per call or per scenario
capacity_algorithm: Unchanged public protocol_calibrate.py for grpc only, separately with actual ON and OFF producer, each --variant after. Common actual EA5-produced client and exact fresh TLS; same ladder/refinement/three confirmation processes and original SLO. After here is only the unchanged calibrator admission label.
comparison_start_gate: Publish and read back the complete new noise-index identity plus its supplemental resource ranges before the first OFF comparison measurement. All later comparison processes must be fresh.
fresh_range_rule: For each p99 and whole-profile CPU/RSS/allocation field, preserve three ON-only process values and maximum-minus-minimum range. No historical bands or replacement samples. Nonfinite/missing remains unavailable. Ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
primary_observations: Separate fresh sustainable successful ordinary business capacity under the same SLO
retention_rule: A source screen is not retention approval. Require actual fresh ON/OFF capacity observations, no failed veto, and a demonstrated primary gain after accounting for recorded noise and capacity-search resolution. Report both primary directions. If results are missing, invalid, inconclusive or an unresolved tradeoff, remove the optional weak reuse. Allocation/CPU gains alone are insufficient. Independent review must accept the concrete actual verdict before final selection.

role_mapping.before: ON2e: retained optional per-transport weak writer

supplemental_observations: Whole-profile CPU and sampled managed allocation
Ordinary per-scenario p99 and process peaks
veto_rule: Retained ON minus OFF equal-weight process mean OR maximum exceeding its corresponding fresh ON-only range is adverse for ordinary p99 or whole-profile CPU/RSS. Any original A21 OFF improvement is an adverse latency cost of retaining ON. Correctness, generator validity, absolute SLO, credits, drain and recovery remain mandatory. CPU or allocation benefit cannot compensate for a failed veto.
